notes.title: One Year of Alvara: Major Update and Playtest Reopened!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Alvarians![/b]

So many new things this October! You’ve been with us for a year now, and Alvara keeps growing day by day thanks to you. Today, we have a [b]huge update! [/b]Here’s a non-exhaustive list of the new features (there are so many that we’re afraid of missing a few :) ):

[list]
[*] Added fatigue and equipment animations for all characters.
[*] Adjusted buttons in the equipment menu (character selection).
[*] Improved cameras during discussions for better immersion.
[*] Created profiles for missing NPCs to display their faces during conversations.
[*] Removed birds in the sky: the rendering wasn’t satisfactory.
[*] Created a new marketing image to better represent the game as a whole.
[*] Tutorial texts: More concise, but still being finalized.
[*] Bug fixes (multiple NPCs appearing in the team, map menu issues, etc.).
[*] Equipment menu change: Now on the first page of the inventory, making it easier to change equipment.
[*] Added a few dead animals for a more realistic atmosphere.
[*] Added a "Tired" pose in combat to visually represent character fatigue.
[*] Improved the tutorial by adding inserts. Jean seemed too knowledgeable, which wasn’t narratively coherent.
[*] Improved some dialogues to enhance response consistency.
[*] Recalibrated final lines that overlapped with player responses.
[*] Added missing character icons in some dialogues.
[*] Fixed a bug making certain items or special abilities unreadable in combat.
[*] Fixed a major bug with Akhakhréna’s fight not starting.
[*] Revised all menu backgrounds.
[*] Fixed minor consistency bugs (quest updates, etc.).
[/list]


What more can we say? A video will show you some of these updates (and not even all of them!)

[previewyoutube=IlWRlOJq_qU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Good news:[/b] the Playtest is open again! Join us to test the latest features and help improve the game.

We’re waiting for you on Discord: https://discord.gg/44BjkxZ4En

Your feedback is invaluable to us, and your Steam reviews, no matter how short, literally keep us going. But like Soana, we know we can count on you. See you soon!

notes.title: Patch Notes – Major Updates and Fixes
notes.content:

[list]

Improved certain dialogues to enhance the coherence of responses.
[*]Recalibrated some final lines that overlapped with player responses.
[*]Added missing character icons in certain dialogues.
[*]Fixed a bug that made some items or special moves unreadable during combat.

We have a lot of new features in this update! Here’s what to expect in this new version:

- [b]Added a skill for Dimitri[/b]: Available for purchase from Daniel.

notes.title: Update of May 24th
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Alvarians,[/h1]

We are thrilled to announce the release of our latest update for Alvara, bringing a multitude of new features and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. Here is a detailed overview of the main changes:

[h2]World[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Vendor Price Variation[/b]: You will now observe price fluctuations at vendors, adding a more realistic economic dimension to your adventure.
[*][b]Zhân's Book[/b]: An explanatory text will appear when you acquire your first Zhân's Book, encouraging you to delve into its reading to uncover all its secrets.
[*][b]Added Tutorial[/b]: To help new players familiarize themselves with the game's mechanics, we have integrated a comprehensive tutorial.
[*][b]New Cinematic for Old Bazzya[/b]: Discover a brand-new cinematic featuring Old Bazzya, enriching the story and immersion.
[*][b]And Now, Expanded LORE[/b]: New writings and statues further enrich the history of Alvara, immersing players in an even richer and more captivating universe.
[/list]
[h2]Combat[/h2] 
[list]
[*][b]Blinking Icon in the Action Order Bar[/b]: Easily visualize the next turn of the selected target with a blinking icon.
[*][b]New Specialty Attacks[/b]: Each character now has a new specialty attack from the start of the game, offering more strategies right away.
[b]New Combat System[/b]:
  [list]
      [*][i]Attack Synergy[/i]: Combine attacks to trigger powerful, coordinated effects.
      [*][i]Fatigue Management[/i]: Take your characters' fatigue into account to optimize your combat strategies.
[/list][/list]
[h2]Menu[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Reorganization of Menu Pages[/b]: Enjoy more intuitive navigation thanks to a reorganization of the menu pages.
[*][b]Redesigned Encyclopedia[/b]: A new design for the encyclopedia with more extensive and numerous texts, facilitating access to information and enriching your understanding of Alvara's world.
[/list]

We hope these additions and improvements make your adventure even more exciting and immersive. Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback. Get ready to rediscover Alvara in a new light!

See you soon in Alvara,

The Development Team

notes.title: Update Journal
notes.content:
A new member has joined the team. The team? Well, when you're alone, you can't really say that, but, well, with 2, we're a team! Let's welcome Petrus properly! His contributions have been more than essential to Alvara!

[h1]What's New?[/h1]

To start, Petrus has reworked all the in-game visuals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/ac4db5efd5594661554c6d273592973ed2487a9a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/2675c7cbc0eac406fa53ebf37b8b279a186aacf7.png[/img]

Visuals aren't the only addition from Petrus. Together, we've thought about making the game more interactive. Previously, Alvara was a rich world but strangely empty. So, we set out to populate it: objects, plants, rocks, etc. Thus, the universe is much more alive, and most importantly, most objects are now interactive. You can pick them up to forge items or make potions! The forging system, although it existed from the beginning, is being perfected. Additionally, alchemy is making its debut in Alvara.

[previewyoutube=LjfBq8boJc4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]What Else?[/h1]

Now, you'll have the opportunity to share much more with your team. In the camps, you can choose to sacrifice some of your rest time to chat with your companions. Whether it's for small concerns or real grievances, these discussions may even lead to new quests!

[previewyoutube=3nPyuBqMalY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Anything More?[/h1]

What else to say, except that the universe is now revealed more, thanks to an encyclopedia that fills up as you make discoveries and progress. Moreover, a calendar system has been introduced: now, Alvarian festivals and the world's history you discover are associated with key dates. But this new time dimension also creates pressure: some NPCs will ask you to complete missions within a specified timeframe.

[previewyoutube=fnYJMwJe9aU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]And What Else?[/h1]

The graphical aspect is being improved: menu harmonization, new graphic identity, etc. And most importantly, new maps are planned for the next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/1672b74ba6f8c3502d33b12847044eec2a77e9e8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/ce26ff518d179d16e876a4a3a9f138700210021b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/dd136f400103f1e0cc9f1180ef4d08851ccb6b48.png[/img]

For now, these new features will soon be in the beta testing phase, which may take some time. But we are confident in announcing the upcoming launch of the game's continuation, which will resemble a true revival!

See you very soon!

Find us on Discord: [https://discord.gg/e4f96BGP](https://discord.gg/e4f96BGP)

Find us on Twitter: [https://twitter.com/mondesdalvara](https://twitter.com/mondesdalvara)

A complete game update thanks to player feedback! Here's the full update list:

[list] [*] Bazzya village completely redesigned and redecorated: the houses have been changed, as have the shadows/lighting and the structure of the village, making it look more like a mountain village. Unnecessary areas (mills, for example) have been removed. Here is the before image : 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/f6420227ed7a53eed1d497afb318c21da7bdc268.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/7fc2cddb17842218254bfc7ac02ecbea40f2a5e9.png[/img][/url] 
And this is what the village looks like now: 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/a6ecf34f259a40d8f90354ec7c47d76f1097556e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/4059a34318523571c55bfa083b45364703983537.png[/img][/url]

[*] The area of forest surrounding the village too: before, the trees prevented good visibility and it was a bit of a mess. Now the trees are higher, the terrain is a little steeper 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/23b077d18f2709fd68d493cdd21311378dc86b06.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/f1281410f46e3dd576094b70a6b233bca47da6e0.png[/img][/url]

[*] Combat optimization: total overhaul of the system, with clearer targeting, clearer information and higher enemy levels, and greater specialization required to defeat enemies.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/5b42321dafd10b33b4a237729ec62e45548fa167.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/1998371595edd32dd2d4742b51029f40976012ab.png[/img][/url]

[*] Apart from that, some improvements (level up sound, etc...)[/list]

Have a great Playday, and don't hesitate to give me feedback so I can further improve your gaming experience!

notes.title: Update 0.1
notes.content:
Here's the list of updates: 
[list] 
[*] Integration of a more explicit warning message concerning the return to the last save when the player decides to quit the game. 
[*] Graphic enhancement of loading capsules to make them more legible
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/5b91642c20bf6fa0709d38a4c6001394ac8301c2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/a7468fe636c395b287d69880ee8df4f8547e1a6b.png[/img][/url].
[*] Modification of the "New mission" banner 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/973cca9c37493dfb2e11fc17df0817d87e3538ef.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/0715aeb7896294ce7864889d6ea5d5d1eee37eab.png[/img][/url]
[*] Removal of the automatic opening of the forge by pressing "Y" (leftover from debugging) 
[*] Updated attitude of enlisted NPCs: the same NPC cannot increase (or decrease) his morale twice if the same (or equivalent) answer is given to a discussion.
[*] Added a collision in the village so that the player can no longer "fall" onto the lake, or exit the village by bypassing the portal. 
[*] Fixed some texts in the English version. 
[*] Reduced the font in the seller menu for sold items. 
[*] Changed the loading screens.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/923dedcefcd30720a38474e3d25cb37634fbe0c4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/350413dcb8e7975ed5c6f12fc6fd65cbf689fc68.png[/img][/url]
[*] Reorganization of the combat interface
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/e99f87b013c50394025fae2f74b7129e136ca866.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44468487/438800c370d2865168e54b594cd796bcf00d519b.png[/img][/url]
[/list]
 That's it for this week! Don't hesitate to send me your feedback, so that I can provide you with the most satisfying game possible! See you soon.
